Observed_Problem: CRM sends review surveys upon estimated delivery date expiration while orders are still delayed in transit.
Empirical_Evidence: 4,976 strict calendar pre-delivery orders exhibit a 72.6% low review rate (adjusted OR = 12.50x, p < 10^-50).
Affected_Segment: In-transit delayed orders across all corridors (4,976 delivered orders, 3,613 low reviews).
Likely_Mechanism: Anxious customers prompted for feedback while packages are missing convert delivery frustration into 1-star reviews.
Recommended_Pilot: A/B test: Holdout group receives current rule; Treatment group suppresses survey until carrier delivery scan + 24 hours.
Success_KPI: Zero pre-delivery surveys; reduction in treatment arm low review rate compared to control.
Experimental_Design: Randomize 50/50 by order_id on orders exceeding estimated delivery date in transit. Measure response rate, review score, and CSAT.

Observed_Problem: São Paulo to Rio de Janeiro linehaul corridor experiences 15.3% late delivery rate and accounts for 13.2% of platform low reviews.
Empirical_Evidence: 8,065 orders, 1,625 low reviews (20.2% low review rate vs 10.7% on SP -> SP). Carrier transit averages 12.8 days.
Affected_Segment: SP -> RJ linehaul trunkline (8,065 orders, R$1.24M GMV).
Likely_Mechanism: Postal sorting bottlenecks entering RJ consume promised delivery buffers, converting transit delays into SLA breaches.
Recommended_Pilot: A/B test: Treatment group receives +2 business days promised buffer at checkout; Control group receives standard heuristic promise.
Success_KPI: SP -> RJ SLA breach rate < 7.5%; monitor checkout cart conversion rate to verify no negative demand elasticity.
Experimental_Design: Geo-randomize checkout delivery estimate displays by RJ postal prefix. Measure cart conversion, on-time delivery rate, and review score.

Intervention_Name: Proactive In-Transit Delay Messaging & Service Recovery
Observed_Problem: Customer review scores collapse non-linearly when delay exceeds 3.5 days (72.4% low review rate).
Empirical_Evidence: Segmented regression identifies sharp structural break at tau=0.5d and logistic steepening past tau=3.5d (5,021 orders, 3,636 low reviews).
Affected_Segment: Shipments delayed >3.5 days past promised date (5,021 orders, R$897K GMV).
Likely_Mechanism: Uncommunicated in-transit delays lead customers to assume packages are lost, destroyed, or abandoned.
Recommended_Pilot: Multi-arm A/B test on Day 3.0 late: (Arm 1) Proactive status alert; (Arm 2) Alert + R$10 credit; (Arm 3) Alert + R$20 credit; (Control) Standard silent tracking.
Success_KPI: Net low review rate in target cohort; customer service ticket volume; 90-day repeat purchase rate.
Experimental_Design: Automated trigger at delay_days == +3.0 days. Randomize into 4 arms. Evaluate incremental ROI per recovered customer.

Observed_Problem: Carrier linehaul transit accounts for 82.5% of fulfillment duration and exhibits 4.0x excess odds of dissatisfaction vs handling.
Empirical_Evidence: Long-haul interstate corridors to Bahia, Pernambuco, and Ceará average 17-24 days transit duration with >14% late rates.
Affected_Segment: Interstate corridors from SP to North/Northeast (6,500+ orders, R$1.15M GMV).
Likely_Mechanism: Over-reliance on public postal service (Correios) hub-and-spoke sorting without private linehaul SLAs.
Recommended_Pilot: Pilot private 3PL linehaul carrier allocation for 20% of volume on SP -> BA corridor. Compare transit times and damage rates.
Success_KPI: Mean corridor transit time < 12 days; carrier-specific late delivery rate < 8%.
Experimental_Design: Split order volume by seller shipping hub; track dock-to-door transit days and carrier invoice SLAs.

Observed_Problem: Black Friday 2017 created an acute fulfillment shock, adding +5.2 days to carrier transit and driving low reviews to 19.3%.
Empirical_Evidence: 89.7% of Black Friday fulfillment shock was absorbed in carrier transit (+5.2d), while merchant handling expanded by only +0.6d.
Affected_Segment: Orders purchased during late November / early December holiday surge (~9,500 orders).
Likely_Mechanism: National carrier parcel sorting saturation and lack of pre-committed dedicated linehaul trailer space.
Recommended_Pilot: Pre-book dedicated linehaul trailers 60 days in advance of peak season for primary trunk routes (SP to RJ, MG, PR).
Success_KPI: Peak season carrier transit surge < +1.5 days above October baseline.
Experimental_Design: Pre-post seasonal comparison with regional control groups.

Intervention_Name: Merchant Warehouse Dispatch SLA Enforcement & Seller Support
Observed_Problem: 9.4% of orders experience warehouse handling delays exceeding 5 days, increasing customer dissatisfaction odds.
Empirical_Evidence: Standardized handling odds ratio is 1.12 per SD; warehouse bottleneck cohort (N=7 sellers) takes 6.8 days avg to dispatch.
Affected_Segment: Orders with merchant handling > 5 days (8,999 orders, 1,992 low reviews).
Likely_Mechanism: Manual seller fulfillment workflows, delayed stock picking, or delayed carrier drop-offs.
Recommended_Pilot: Graduated seller intervention: (1) Automated dispatch reminders at 24h/48h; (2) Seller coaching for slow merchants; (3) Buy-box demotion for chronic offenders (>5d handling).
Success_KPI: Orders with dispatch > 5 days reduced from 9.4% to < 3.0%.
Experimental_Design: Roll out automated dispatch reminders to 50% of slow seller cohort; monitor handling duration and order cancellation rates.

Observed_Problem: High-volume bulky categories (bed_bath_table, furniture_decor) accumulate significant negative reviews due to handling complexity.
Empirical_Evidence: Category x lateness moderation is statistically negligible (partial eta^2 = 0.073%), but bulky categories represent 34.8% of low reviews.
Affected_Segment: Top bulky product categories with high dimensional weight (18,000+ orders).
Likely_Mechanism: Packaging damage, irregular parcel handling by postal carriers, and dimensional freight surcharges.
Recommended_Pilot: Provide standardized packaging guidelines and discounted pre-sized corrugated boxes to top 50 furniture/bedding merchants.
Success_KPI: Carrier damage claim rate < 0.5%; packaging-related customer complaint mentions reduced by 30%.
Experimental_Design: Cohort pilot across top 50 merchants in bed_bath_table; evaluate returns and review comment text sentiment.
